main_measure.name: mean unusual next-day move in the short direction on case bars

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day grouped

main_measure.threshold: confirm above 0 with t >= 2 (and check above 0); reject below 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: deeper half minus shallower half of |forecast|, mean unusual move

decided_by: Only 91 case days, below the plan's minimum of 100 case days.
reading: Cases are short-side forecast rises of at least 2 points from the lowest level since the last bet on every bar (1-bar grid), the coin's mean is its mean next-bar return over all its windows, the halves split the cases sorted by |forecast| at n//2 (shallower first, odd case to the deeper half), and the situation check uses r1>0 and r5<0 from closes (profile not recomputed).
